notes: Settings now has a Close button at the top right, and clicking a course or a view takes you straight back to your work. Coming from an older version? You also get Settings in four tabs (click your name at the bottom left), a way to choose which classes you are in, a tidier window and a clearer sync line, and on a Mac, no more security warnings or keychain pop-ups (Sybl will ask you to sign in once more).
